title: Unirationality is the same thing as Rational Connectedness in Characteristic Zero
summary: In this paper we prove that unirationality, rational connectedness and rational chain connectedness coincide for smooth projective varieties over a field $ k $ of characteristic zero. Our approach uses the MRC fibration to show that if $ X $ is a smooth projective variety, then there exists a variety $ \operatorname{MU}(X) $, together with rational maps $ π: X \dashrightarrow \operatorname{MU}(X) $ and $ λ: \operatorname{MU}(X) \dashrightarrow \operatorname{MRC}(X) $, such that i) if $ ν: X \dashrightarrow \operatorname{MRC}(X) $, then $ λ\circ π= ν$ on the appropriate domains; ii) the very…
